title: Shielding in Resource-Constrained Goal POMDPs
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical aspects of "safe decision making" in the context of resource constraints in Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs). Specifically, it aims to prevent "resource exhaustion" and ensure "goal reachability" at minimal expected cost. It does not discuss broader ethical implications, moral frameworks, religious beliefs, or related epistemological considerations beyond the technical definition of safety within its model.
